01-evidence-span-checker
Evidence Span Checker
Check whether a cited quotation exists in the cited source.
Exact whitespace-normalized matching verifies quotation presence, not whether the quote supports a claim. No web retrieval.
Add source page and section identifiers; test an authentic-looking quote paired with an unrelated claim.
02-numeric-answer-checker
Numeric Answer Checker
Compare a reported quantity against a reference after unit conversion.
Supports only m/mm and kg/g; absolute tolerance is in the reference unit. Does not validate engineering designs.
Add a test for a tolerance boundary and support centimetres with dimensional validation.
03-delivery-reconciler
Delivery Reconciler
Compare ordered and delivered mass by zone and bar diameter.
Synthetic mass reconciliation only. Repeated ticket IDs are rejected; tickets must already be legible and transcribed. No OCR or compliance verdict.
Add a duplicate-ticket rejection test and separate rejected/illegible tickets from accepted records.
04-revision-conflict-detector
Revision Conflict Detector
Find field changes between two structured document revisions.
Compares JSON records by ID; cannot decide which revision is authorized. Duplicate record IDs are rejected.
Add revision dates and an explicit source-priority rule; keep conflicts visible until a human resolves them.
05-annotation-agreement
Annotation Agreement Calculator
Calculate raw agreement and Cohen kappa for two annotators.
Assumes aligned, categorical labels for the same items and two raters. Undefined kappa returns null; tiny samples are not reliable quality estimates.
Add item IDs and a disagreement review queue; explain why high raw agreement can still mislead.
06-pairwise-preference-report
Pairwise Preference Report
Summarize human A/B preferences, ties, and invalid votes.
Summarizes supplied votes; does not judge answers, remove position bias, or establish statistical significance.
Add blinded model IDs, randomized answer positions, and confidence intervals for enough independent votes.
07-dataset-leakage-check
Dataset Leakage Check
Find normalized exact duplicates shared by train and evaluation sets.
Catches exact text after case and whitespace normalization only. Misses paraphrases, semantic leakage, and overlaps inside larger documents.
Add near-duplicate detection and compare its false positives with exact matching.
08-agent-trace-auditor
Agent Trace Auditor
Flag unapproved actions, repeated failed calls, and budget overruns in recorded agent traces.
Offline policy checks over a synthetic event schema. Approval applies to the exact action ID. Not a live agent, security boundary, or sandbox.
Add tests for unrelated approvals and repeated failed calls. Design expiring, single-use approval semantics.
09-json-output-validator
Structured Output Validator
Check flat JSON responses for required fields, field types, and unexpected keys.
Small fixed type system, not a JSON Schema implementation. No nested objects, ranges, or semantic correctness checking.
Add nested validation or adopt a full schema library, then document the tradeoff.
10-retrieval-ranking-evaluator
Retrieval Ranking Evaluator
Measure precision, recall, and reciprocal rank for retrieved document IDs.
Evaluates retrieval IDs against supplied relevance labels, not answer faithfulness. Duplicates are removed in ranking order.
Evaluate multiple queries and report averages with a documented no-relevant-documents policy.
11-evaluation-regression-gate
Evaluation Regression Gate
Compare baseline and candidate pass/fail results on the same test IDs.
Rejects missing or added cases for comparability. Uses fixed synthetic booleans, not a statistical significance test or live model benchmark.
Add severity weights and repeated runs for nondeterministic model outputs.
12-human-review-queue
Human Review Queue
Rank evaluation cases using explicit severity and confidence rules.
A deterministic triage heuristic; confidence is supplied rather than calibrated. Not an autonomous hiring, medical, or legal decision system.
Add reviewer disposition and audit history; check whether the priority rule overloads the queue.
